gemini.rationale: The slice describes a spin-off of HSNi from IAC. The customer-facing businesses (T4), operating processes (T5), and organization (T6) were transferred together as an operating business into a newly formed entity. There is no documented structural mismatch between T4 and T5, or T5 and T6, at closing.

grok.rationale: The slice states the customer-facing HSN/Cornerstone operating businesses were transferred into newly formed HSNi as they had been conducted within IAC’s Retailing segment, so T4 product and T5 processes crossed together (gap_45=0). An Employee Matters Agreement and the transfer of the operating businesses likewise moved people/organization with operations, with only limited residual shared services bridged by a Transition Services Agreement (gap_56=0); no product-vs-process or process-vs-organization structural mismatch is documented at closing.

openai.rationale: The slice states that HSN television/HSN.com, the Cornerstone brands, and related retail operations transferred into HSNi as operating businesses, so the customer-facing products and their operating processes moved together; no T4–T5 mismatch is documented. Although the slice does not expressly establish the extent of personnel transfer, it identifies an Employee Matters Agreement and limited transition services and documents no closing-time mismatch between transferred processes and the organization running them; therefore gap_56 is coded 0 under the required conservative standard.
